description: Zone of control as a pathfinder seam: with the frontier ruleset's zone_of_control on, no walked path ever passes through a cell beside an enemy - a unit may step in beside one, but the move ends there. The metric replays every move against who stood where at the time, so it catches a path that slipped past a unit that later died. Proves BattleRuleset.can_continue_from reaches Pathfinder.reachable; random play, because the frontier AI only ever approaches and stops, so it never runs past anyone; with the hook absent random armies walk through freely, which is the RED half of the claim.
